full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows a pale dancer resting beside two white swans and a spray of ivory blossoms in a dark, softly enclosed setting. The background is mottled charcoal and brown, with a worn vignette deepening at the corners. The dancer sits left of center, her knees drawn together and her long legs extending diagonally toward the lower right. She wears a textured ivory bodice, a short layered skirt full of soft feathers and ruffles, white tights, and pale satin pointe shoes. A cluster of large white flowers crowns her light hair. Her head tilts downward; one hand supports the side of her face, and the lowered eyes and still mouth give the pose a pensive calm. Behind and to the right, a tall vase carries abundant cream blossoms on delicate branching stems. Two swans occupy the right foreground, their long curved necks and pale bodies forming a soft counterpoint to the dancer's diagonal legs. The nearer bird faces right; the smaller head appears between the dancer and the vase. Loose feathers and flower fragments lie across the dim lower floor. Soft light from the upper left brings the face, sleeves, skirt, stockings, blossoms, and swan necks out of the dark, leaving the wall and floor in deep brown shadow. The rendering is photographic in the face and cloth folds but softened by painterly haze, grain, and irregular worn edges. The many ivory textures remain distinct: smooth satin, translucent ruffles, fluffy feathers, and clustered petals. A cursive signature-like mark appears at the lower left, but it is not part of the pictured scene. The overall composition is intimate and theatrical, using pale organic forms against darkness to create a fragile, dreamlike stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式肖像呈现一名浅色衣裙的舞者，在幽暗、柔和围合的空间中坐在两只白天鹅与象牙色花枝旁休息。背景斑驳炭黑与棕色，四角有磨旧般的深色暗角。舞者坐在中央偏左，双膝靠拢，长腿斜向右下方伸出。她穿有肌理的象牙色上身、满是柔羽与褶饰的短层叠裙、白色连裤袜和浅色缎面足尖鞋。大片白花簇拥浅色头发。她低着头，一只手托住脸侧，低垂的眼睛和静止的嘴唇使姿态显得沉思平静。后方偏右，高花瓶插着大量奶油色花朵，细枝向外伸展。两只天鹅位于右前景，弯曲长颈与浅色身体柔和呼应舞者斜伸的腿。较近的鸟朝右，较小的鸟头出现在舞者与花瓶之间。松散羽毛与花瓣碎片撒在暗色地面。来自左上方的柔光把面部、袖子、裙子、袜子、花朵和天鹅颈部从黑暗中带出，让墙和地面留在深棕影里。脸与布褶带摄影式真实感，却被绘画薄雾、颗粒与不规则磨旧边缘柔化。多种象牙色肌理仍各不相同：平滑缎面、半透明褶边、蓬松羽毛和聚簇花瓣。左下方有一处草写署名般的痕迹，但它不属于画面情景。整体构图亲近而有舞台感，以黑暗中的浅色有机形营造脆弱、梦境般的静止。
style_prompt_en: Painterly photographic imagery concentrates pale ivory and cream forms inside a dark brown-charcoal vignette. Soft directional light creates luminous islands of detail, then lets their edges dissolve gradually into shadow. Texture is layered and tactile: fine grain, gauzy softness, feathery broken highlights, smooth satin-like gleams, and mottled worn surfaces coexist without flattening into one material. The brightest areas form a linked diagonal rhythm, while a dark perimeter contains the composition. Color is nearly monochromatic but retains warm beige, muted blush, and cool gray shifts within the whites. Selective sharpness brings a focal passage forward; adjacent forms remain soft and atmospheric. Organic curves and dense pale clusters balance open black-brown gaps. The overall effect is romantic and introspective, with restrained light and material variation carrying the mood.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式摄影影像把浅象牙与奶油色形体集中在深棕炭色暗角内。柔和定向光形成发亮的细节岛屿，再让边缘逐渐消融进阴影。肌理层叠而有触感：细颗粒、薄纱般柔度、羽毛般断续亮笔、缎面似的平滑微光与斑驳磨旧表面并存，却不混成同一种材料。最亮区域连成一条斜向节奏，深色周边收束构图。色彩近乎单色，却在白色内部保留暖米、灰粉和冷灰变化。选择性清晰度把焦点推到前方，相邻形体仍柔软而有气氛。有机曲线与密集浅色簇群平衡开放的黑棕间隙。整体效果浪漫而内省，由克制的光和材料变化承载情绪。
theme_en: A pale dancer resting beside white swans and blossoms
theme_zh: 一名浅色衣裙的舞者在白天鹅与花枝旁休憩
name: Kathy Fornal
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
